name: A cheaper tier for simple calls
gain: Projected from your bill and the provider's listed prices, once a test set passes on the cheaper model.
how: Move calls that pass the test set to the next tier down
replaces: A top model on simple work.
trade_offs: Quality may drop on hard calls; the test set decides.
usage_signal: Usage and Cost API: one model holds nearly all spend across differently shaped calls

inputs.name: calls_moved
inputs.source: the product's usage data or the bill

inputs.name: top_cost_per_call
inputs.source: the product's usage data or the bill

inputs.name: cheaper_cost_per_call
inputs.source: the product's usage data or the bill

test_recipe.what_to_compare: quality on the product's own test set, cost

verify_rule: Spend by model and the eval score over 14 days

change_recipe.how: Move calls that pass the test set to the next tier down
change_recipe.left_off: Nothing else changes; the new path sits behind a setting until a person turns it on
